pages.title: Server policy
pages.text: speakerRange sets the range ceiling: 1–512, default 64. disableUpload blocks uploads. allowRemoteStreams defaults off and is independent of uploads.

pages.title: Limits and cache
pages.text: maxUploadSize defaults to 5 MiB, capped at 100 MiB.$(br2)Your audio cache budget is a personal choice in Settings > Your listening settings.

pages.title: Connected policy
pages.text: Server policy overrides server limits while connected, but never your listening preferences.

pages.title: Debug logs
pages.text: debugLogging enables detailed logs.$(br2)Enable it when diagnosing a problem, then disable it to reduce log volume.
